verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own spec page gives the memory type (LPDDR5x) and a bandwidth figure (up to 228 GB/s), which covers two of the story's three elements. The evidence also records that Qualcomm does not publish a max-memory-capacity figure, so the capacity ceiling cannot be taken from vendor numbers. missing for 10: published maximum memory capacity, bus width/data-rate detail to independently derive bandwidth, independent corroboration of the bandwidth figure.

support.subject: As a developer, I can size memory-bound workloads from the vendor's own numbers — published memory type, capacity ceiling, and bandwidth (or spec detail complete enough to derive it)

citations.quote: up to 228 GB/s LPDDR5x memory bandwidth, as stated by Qualcomm
